spans.s:
Śrauta-ṛṣi or Śrautarṣi, ‘descendant of Srutaṛṣi or Śrutarṣi,’ is the patronymic of devabhāga.
Foot notes aitareya brāhmaṇa, vii. 1, 6.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, ii. 4, 4, 5; taittirīya brāhmaṇa, iii. 10, 9, 11.
Śraumatya, ‘descendant of Śrumant,’ is the name of a teacher in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa (x. 4, 5, 1).
